operations.description: Export the tickets changed since start_time, one page per call of at most per_page tickets; the first call sends start_time, each later call sends the previous page's after_cursor as cursor, and the walk ends on a page with end_of_stream true
Read one ticket by ticket_id, without its comment thread

List one ticket's comments by cursor, one page per call; the walk sends meta.after_cursor as page[after]. When meta.has_more is present it decides: false ends the walk, true continues even past an empty page and is an error without meta.after_cursor. Without meta.has_more the walk ends on a page with no meta.after_cursor or no comments. A cursor seen before is an error.

List one ticket's audits by cursor, one page per call; the walk sends meta.after_cursor as page[after]. When meta.has_more is present it decides: false ends the walk, true continues even past an empty page and is an error without meta.after_cursor. Without meta.has_more the walk ends on a page with no meta.after_cursor or no audits. A cursor seen before is an error.

Export the users changed since start_time, one page per call; the first call sends start_time, each later call sends the previous page's after_cursor as cursor, and the walk ends on a page with end_of_stream true
Export the organizations changed since start_time, one page per call; each later call sends the previous page's end_time as start_time, and the walk ends on a page with end_of_stream true

Change one ticket's group_id, tags, priority or type, at least one of them; tags replaces the ticket's whole tag set. Send the ticket's updated_at from ticket.show as updated_stamp: the update is refused before it is sent when the ticket changed since, and as conflict when it changes in between

Add a private internal note to one ticket, never public; a note sent twice is two notes. Send the ticket's updated_at from ticket.show as updated_stamp: the note is refused before it is sent when the ticket changed since, and as conflict when it changes in between

Add a draft reply to one ticket: a private note whose first line marks it as a draft, which a person copies into a public reply; nothing is sent to the requester, and a draft sent twice is two notes. Send the ticket's updated_at from ticket.show as updated_stamp: the draft is refused before it is sent when the ticket changed since, and as conflict when it changes in between

body_prefixes./ticket/comment/body: [Draft reply - not sent to the requester]
